record.one_liner: Command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG, PNG or PDF.
record.auth_notes: Local CLI/library with no account or API key; the docs describe only installing the package and running mmdc or calling a Node.js function.
record.access_notes: Installed from npm with no sign-up; no credentials needed.
record.api_notes: Documented surface is the mmdc CLI and a Node.js run() function; the Node.js API is explicitly not covered by semver. No HTTP API.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready -> blocked; main_blocker not_a_saas contradicted verdict ready. Local CLI/library with no hosted HTTP API to authorise. critic: mcp community -> official; Mermaid's own site (mermaid.ai) documents a vendor-hosted Mermaid MCP Server at mcp.mermaid.ai (requires a free Mermaid account), though it targets the Mermaid hosted product rather than the CLI itself.
